title: WTO | GATT members
content:
The 128 countries that had signed GATT by 1994
WTO replaced GATT, which had been in existence since 1947, as the organization overseeing
the multilateral trading system. The governments that had signed GATT were officially
known as  “GATT contracting parties”. Upon signing the new WTO agreements
